Career Area: 
Technology, Digital and Data 
 Job Description: 
 
 Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 
 
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 Cat Digital is the digital and technology arm of Caterpillar Inc., leveraging the latest technologies to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers. With over 1.5 million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics, and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world.
  
 Job Summary: 
  
 The PIM Platform Software Engineer configures and builds on the Akeneo platform while supporting Informatica P360 during the migration window. You implement workflows, enrichment rules, attributes, taxonomy, and Akeneo extensions, and help build and troubleshoot the API integrations that connect Akeneo to upstream and downstream systems.
  
 What You Will Do: 
  
 Configure and support Akeneo, including workflow implementation, attribute modeling, and taxonomy setup
 Maintain and support Informatica P360 in parallel during the transition period
 Build and maintain Akeneo extensions and custom capabilities using the Akeneo Extension SDK
 Build and troubleshoot REST API integrations between Akeneo, upstream, and downstream systems
 Support P360-to-Akeneo migration engineering: data mapping, validation, and cutover support
 Resolve data defects and product data quality issues surfaced during enrichment or migration
 Establish and follow reusable PIM engineering patterns so implementations stay consistent across domains
 Participate in code/design review and follow CI/CD practices for releases
  
 What You Will Have: 
   
 Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
 Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements.
 Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace.
 Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages.
 Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.

 Considerations For Top Candidates: 
   
 Experience with Akeneo (or a comparable PIM platform) configuration and implementation, or strong aptitude to ramp quickly
 Working knowledge of Informatica P360 or similar MDM/PIM platforms, a plus
 Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable with npm and building SDK-based extensions
 Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON/XML data structures, and integration patterns
 SQL proficiency for data validation and troubleshooting
 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking (Jira/Azure DevOps)
 Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across platform, data, and integration issues
 Hands-on technical background in Akeneo
 Strong architecture and solution-design review experience, including API and integration design
 Experience leading platform migrations (system-to-system data and workflow migration)
 Comfortable owning delivery execution: backlog management, sprint planning, release readiness
 Strong communicator who can align architecture, business, and delivery teams
 
 Additional Details: 
  
 This position requires the candidate to be in Chicago, IL, Peoria, IL, Broomfield, CO or Irving, TX
 Relocation assistance is NOT available for this position
 Visa sponsorship is NOT available with this position.
 This position will require up to 10% travel
 
 Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. 
  
 What You Will Get:  
  
 Working with a Fortune 100 leader, you can build your career on a global scale and take advantage of development opportunities with emerging technologies. We’ve created an inclusive environment for you to explore your passions, make an impact and do the work that really matters. Join Us. 
  
 About Caterpillar  
  
 Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

$97,530.00 - $158,480.00 
 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.
